convert_gguf_tokenizer: convert a GGUF tokenizer dictionary to a HuggingFace fast tokenizer for a given model architecture
build_gguf_config_mapping: build GGUF metadata mapping from model config attributes to GGUF tensor keys for supported architectures
create_gguf_tokenizer_skeleton: create a GGUF tokenizer skeleton class that parses tokenizer dictionary into tokens, scores, merges, and special token IDs
build_gguf_llama_converter: build a GGUF-aware Llama converter that transforms GGUF tokenizer data into a HuggingFace fast BPE tokenizer
build_gguf_gemma_converter: build a GGUF-aware Gemma converter that handles Unigram model vocab with special token normalization for tabs and spaces
